# CLAUDE.md — Smart Operator Assistant (Caterpillar Hackathon)

This file is read by Claude Code at the start of every session. Keep it short and current.

## What we are building
An end-to-end assistant for operators of CAT construction machines (excavators, wheel loaders,
dozers, articulated trucks), plus a site manager dashboard. It covers daily tasks, real-time
safety, machine health, training, unusual-behaviour detection and task time estimation.
**All data is synthetic** and generated by our own simulator (`data/generator/`).

## Read these before changing anything
| Doc | Read it when |
|---|---|
| `docs/features.md` | You need to know what a feature does and its priority (P0/P1/P2) |
| `docs/architecture.md` | You touch how services talk to each other |
| `docs/schema.md` + `supabase/migrations/` | You read or write the database |
| `docs/api_contract.md` | You add or call an endpoint, event or realtime channel |
| `docs/models.md` | You train, change or call an ML model or the alert rule engine |
| `docs/synthetic_data.md` | You change the data generator |
| `docs/design.md` | You write any UI |
| `docs/supabase.md` | You touch auth, RLS, realtime, storage or pgvector |
| `docs/roadmap.md` | You want to know what to build next |

The database schema in `supabase/migrations/` is the source of truth for column names.
If a doc disagrees with the migration, the migration wins — then fix the doc.

## Repo layout
```
data/generator/      Python synthetic data generator  -> data/output/*.csv|parquet
ml/                  training notebooks, saved models in ml/artifacts/
vision/              webcam service: YOLO proximity, MediaPipe fatigue, phone detection
backend/             FastAPI: inference, alert engine, telemetry replay, RAG, handover LLM
web/                 React + Vite + TS app, two modes: /operator (PWA, cab) and /manager
supabase/            migrations, seed, storage policies
docs/                all planning docs
```

## Stack
Supabase (Postgres, Auth, Realtime, Storage, pgvector) · FastAPI (Python 3.12) ·
React 18 + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind · LightGBM, XGBoost, scikit-learn · Ultralytics YOLO,
MediaPipe · faster-whisper, Piper TTS · Leaflet maps · Recharts.

## Hard rules
1. **Never train on `anomaly_label` / `anomaly_type`.** They are ground truth for evaluation only.
2. **No automatic force-stop of a machine.** Use the graded response in `docs/models.md`
   (warn → derate → recommend safe shutdown → escalate). A machine may be lifting a load or on a slope.
3. **Schema changes go in a new numbered migration** (`supabase/migrations/00N_*.sql`). Never edit
   an applied migration. Regenerate TS types after: `supabase gen types typescript --linked > web/src/types/supabase.ts`.
4. **The Supabase service-role key lives only in `backend/.env`.** The web app uses the anon key + RLS.
5. **UI uses design tokens from `docs/design.md`.** No ad-hoc hex values, no new fonts.
   Saffron is for interaction only, never for status. Status colours always come with an icon and a text label.
6. **Operator mode is used with gloves in a vibrating cab:** touch targets ≥ 64px, body text ≥ 18px.
7. Every offline-capable write carries a client-generated `client_id` (uuid) so sync is idempotent.
8. Synthetic entity IDs are readable text: sites `S1`, machines `M01`, operators `OP01`,
   shifts `SH-<date>-<machine>-<D|N>`, tasks `T-<shift>-<n>`.

## Conventions
- Python: ruff + black, type hints, pydantic models for every API payload.
- TypeScript: strict mode, no `any`, supabase-js typed client.
- DB: snake_case, timestamps are `timestamptz` in UTC, UI shows Asia/Kolkata.
- Units in column names: `_c`, `_kpa`, `_bar`, `_lph`, `_pct`, `_kmh`, `_m`, `_min`, `_deg`.
- Commits: `feat(scope): …`, `fix(scope): …`, scopes = data, ml, vision, backend, web, db, docs.

## Commands (fill in as they become real)
```
# data
python data/generator/generate.py --config data/generator/config.yaml --sample   # 1 day, M01+M06 -> data/output/sample/
python data/generator/generate.py --config data/generator/config.yaml            # full 90 days -> data/output/ (~30 s)
python -m nbconvert --to notebook --execute --inplace data/generator/validation.ipynb           # all validation checks
python data/generator/load_to_supabase.py --days 14 --reset                      # last 14 days -> Supabase (needs data/.env)
# backend
cd backend && uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
cd backend && python -m pytest                                                    # rules, scenarios, events, predict/plan, jobs, auth, AI (no DB or LLM needed)
python backend/scripts/ingest_docs.py                                             # kb/*.md -> documents + document_chunks (idempotent; --dry-run)
python backend/tests/rag_eval.py --judge-model gemini-flash-lite-latest           # 25 RAG questions against the live LLM (~12 min on the free tier)
TOKEN=$(python backend/scripts/get_token.py)                                     # manager JWT (priya); every endpoint but /health needs one
curl -X POST localhost:8000/replay/start -H "authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"machine_ids":["M04","M05"],"from":"2026-08-19T15:15:00Z","speed":10}'   # demo window
curl -X POST localhost:8000/scenario/overheating -H "authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"machine_id":"M05"}'
curl -X POST "localhost:8000/analytics/cluster?week_start=2026-08-17" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"   # fleet clustering for a week
# vision
python vision/run.py --camera 0 --backend http://localhost:8000                 # posts with $VISION_API_TOKEN (same value as backend/.env)
python vision/run.py calibrate --distance 3                                       # once per camera -> vision/calibration.json
python vision/run.py --camera 0 --sector rear --machine-id M05 --dry-run          # print events; --source demo.mp4 as fallback
python vision/run.py --mode fatigue --camera 0 --operator-id OP02 --dry-run      # fatigue on the webcam; --shift-type night, --machine-moving
python vision/run.py --mode both --camera 1 --cab-camera 0 --dry-run              # proximity + fatigue; --cab-camera takes an index, URL or file
cd vision && python -m pytest                                                     # vision tests (no camera needed)
# web
cd web && npm run dev                                                             # /operator, /manager, /styleguide
cd web && npm run build                                                           # tsc strict + vite build + PWA
# db
supabase db push
```

## Virtual environments (Windows paths; not committed)
- `backend/.venv` ← `backend/requirements.txt` — runs backend tests: `cd backend && .venv/Scripts/python -m pytest`
- `ml/.venv` ← `ml/requirements.txt` — runs ml tests: `cd ml && .venv/Scripts/python -m pytest`
- Both are built on Python 3.12.1 (the version that trained `ml/artifacts/`). Refresh with
  `.venv/Scripts/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt`. Don't run tests with the system Python.

## When you finish a task
Tick its checkbox in `docs/roadmap.md` and note any new decision in the relevant doc.
